newsitem.title: USA: Colorado Gaming rejects Jackpot bid.
newsitem.headline: Colorado Gaming rejects Jackpot bid.

text.p: Colorado Gaming & Entertainment Co said Wednesday its board has rejected a merger offer from Jackpot Enterprises Inc, saying the bid was inadequate.
The company did not disclose the amount of Jackpot's offer and a company spokeswoman had no immediate comment.
Colorado Gaming said it is in discussions to be acquired by an unrelated party "which the company's board believes would provide greater value to its shareholders than the offer by Jackpot."

Colorado Gaming owns and operates three limited stakes casinos in Colorado located in the towns of Black Hawk and Central City. The casinos, operating under the names of Bullwhackers and Silver Hawk, offer combined gaming space of approximately 25,000 square feet, with approximately 1,250 gaming devices and 23 gaming tables.
